messages:
Maya: Quick async — where are we on aurora-7b intake + licensing? Targeting catalog launch next Tue. Two gating items: 1) Legal signoff on license/redistribution, 2) Perf profiles for generation and embeddings (common shapes). Anyone blocked? Reply with ETA.
Alex: I spun up a staging run last night. Model loads fine. Running short perf pass now, should have p50/p95 for gen+embeds EOD today. Full sweep (batch shapes + quant) queued.
Ricardo: I'm on the license review. There's a clause about redistribution requiring attribution — looks OK but want to confirm exact wording for the model card. ETA tomorrow 12:00pm PT.
Sophia: For runtime perf we need typical payloads + batch sizes. Can you paste a sample request (prompt + embedding_pool_len)? Also, are we testing seq=128 and seq=512?
Maya: sample payload below — embeddings using pool_len=512 and generation average seq=128. Please use batch sizes: gen batch=8, embed batch=32.
```json
{
  "input": "Summarize the following doc:\n...",
  "generation": {"max_tokens": 128, "temperature": 0.2},
  "embeddings": {"pool_len": 512}
}
```
Chris: Infra note — we have capacity in the dedicated pool but need the manifest to include owner label and kernel pin (CUDA/rocm). I can reserve nodes once PR with manifest changes is open.
Kevin: I will finalize the public-facing model name and one-line blurb today so docs can stage.
Alex: Quick short-run perf numbers (staging, vram-32): gen p50=42ms @seq128, p95=210ms; embeddings p50=24ms @pool512. Full sweep will capture throughput at batches.
Alex: Perf dashboard (short-run): https://redwood.internal/perf/aurora-7b/short-run (internal)
Ricardo: Legal note — attribution requirement ok, no redistribution ban. We'll provide approved snippet to paste in model card. Will DM the exact wording.
Sophia: Added a draft perf profile to the catalog with gen+embed sections and a quantization rec (q4f) based on short-run numbers. Needs Alex's full-sweep numbers to finalize.
Maya: Ok blockers mostly cleared. Checklist: legal signoff (Ricardo) — in progress, perf profile in catalog — draft present, manifest changes for infra — PR needed. Chris please confirm when manifest PR opens/merges.
Chris: PR opened: https://git.internal/repos/model-manifests/pull/212 — will run infra smoke tests then merge. ETA ~2 hours.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT if manifest PR merges and healthchecks pass.
Maya: Awesome. I'll update the launch tracker and ping docs to prepare the model card with Ricardo's snippet and Kevin's blurb. Thanks everyone :tada:
Alex: I'll post full sweep results in this thread once done.
Ricardo: Will drop approved attribution text here when ready.
Sophia: Noted — will run final regression after full sweep
